context:
Goal: close a guard hole where a harmless git command in one folder lets a branch switch in another folder through.
Problem (rule): the guard reads only the first folder a command line names, and its code comment says you ruled that on Nov 10, but no record holds the ruling, so changing it needs your word.
Based on (read): the comment in the guard's folder reader (hooks/guard_core.py, commit dac648673, Nov 10).
Departs from: main — the first named folder wins; the fix reads each command's own folder.
home: step notes-fix-reverify-small (re-check small fixes from review notes)

options.gain: A branch switch in another folder is judged on its own folder.
options.how: The guard judges each command on the line by the folder that command names.
options.label: Read each command's folder (Recommended)
options.lose: Reverses the reading the code comment says you ruled.

options.how: The guard keeps reading only the first folder named.
options.label: Keep the first folder

title: Let the guard read each command's own folder, not only the first one named
why: A code comment says you ruled the current reading; no record holds that ruling.
